notes.title: Seasonal PvP, Auto mode in PvP, and more!
notes.content:
Adventurers, long time no see. We... missed you! And we're very happy to be back with a major update to our favorite little game. Today, we're adding a new game mode, putting more "Auto" into Auto Brawl Chess, and fixing long-requested issues that have plagued us all for far too long. Let's dive right into the changes!
[h2]⚔️ Seasonal Ranked PvP[/h2]
A lot of your feedback has been about having too many heroes available in combat. Shops get too diverse, and it's hard to even get a 3rd star on a common hero. Today, we're addressing this with a new game mode that you can play instead of regular Ranked Seasonal PvP.
[list]
[*] Introducing Seasonal PvP, a new Ranked game mode that you can play any time and receive the same rewards and Rank Points as you would in regular PvP!
[*] In Seasonal PvP, you have a limited roster of heroes, with only 6 factions participating at a given time. This means that when you start a fight, you and your opponents will only see heroes from 6 factions in the combat shop.
[*] To play, just toggle the "Seasonal" button next to the "Play" button on the main screen. You can always turn it off to play regular Ranked PvP with heroes from all factions.
[*] Seasons change every 14 days (starting this Friday) at 10:00 UTC.
[/list]The next three seasons will look as follows:
[list]
[*] The first season (until Aug 9th): Drifters, Demons, Undead, Primals, Reptile, Beasts.
[*] Aug 9th — Aug 23rd: Demons, Drifters, Elves, Darkspawn, Undead, Tribe
[*] Aug 23rd — Sept 6th: Drifters, Elves, Beasts, Demons, Empire, Dwarves.
[/list]We will keep you updated on the schedule of upcoming seasons in our regular event announcements.
[h2]🤖 Autofight Changes[/h2]
Auto Brawl Chess sometimes feels like it lacks the "Auto" part of its name. It's time to take our game to the next level!
[list]
[*] Introducing PvP Autofight: play the game from the comfort of your whatever, completely hands-free! Why would you do that? Because you're too busy of an adventurer! Events this, Journey that, you simply don't have enough time to micromanage your little combatting heroes.
[*] It's all very simple: just tap the "Auto" button next to your bench in combat, and see your device make decisions for you!
[*] Besides automating your Ranked battles, you can now also enjoy PvE battles in Journey, the Dungeon, and Events for the low, low price of nothing. Yes, the PvE Autofight is now free!
[/list][h2]⚙️ General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhanced anti-cheating measures: our game's security has been upgraded to the latest tech, so you can be sure that your opponents are playing fair.
[*] A longstanding sync issue in Tournament and Friend PvP has been fixed: now it is impossible for you to kill your opponent, only to receive the "Defeat" window afterward.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]
Still reading? Very well. Have a promo code: [b]VERYAUTOCHESS[/b]
This one's on us 😉

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
ADVENTURERS!

Our latest update is here! It is packed with a range of exciting new changes and improvements.

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the new Phoenix and Angel Leagues! Ascend to even higher ranks, beat even more challenges and claim greater rewards.
[*] Monster Changes: Trimming Chester’s power a little to even out the playing field.
[*] Pet Changes: Diego Jr. is given a fresh new rework, which certainly will make him more enticing to pick. Amaru, Fenrir and Pino have also received a small boost, with Rukkur taking a slight nerf.
[*] New optimization features to make the game run that much smoother on all devices.
[*] Additional minor bug fixes and improvements to your experience in Pangea.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Released!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of a new hotfix aimed at improving your gaming experience. This update includes a fix for a recent Tournament issue, as well as addressing some minor bugs.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience. We invite you to join the Insane Tournament this Friday! Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled adventure!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
[h2]ADVENTURERS![/h2]

Our latest update is here! In this patch, we're introducing Duels: low-stakes battles with friends. Check out the full list of changes below:
[list]
[*] You can now summon your friends to a Duel! Fight each other 1 on 1 using special new rules.
[*] In Duels, each player starts with only 3 hit points, but each round victory result in the loser taking just 1 point of damage!
[*] Each Duel costs 1 Duel Ticket. You can find them in weekly quest rewards, buy, or exchange for gems.
[*] Fixed localization issues in some languages.
[*] Fixed other minor issues.
[/list]
